items.label: All three 180°
items.ask: Why do the angles in a triangle add to 180?

explain.say: Draw any triangle on paper: big, small, thin or fat. Measure the three angles and add them. You always get 180 degrees! Look at this triangle's angles: 50, 60 and 70.

explain.say: Here is something you can try at home. Tear off the three corners. Look at angle A, 50 degrees. Put it down next to a straight line.

explain.say: Now put angle B, 60 degrees, right beside it. Then angle C. What do you think the three corners make together?

items.label: All three 180°
items.ask: Why do the angles in a triangle add to 180?

explain.say: A straight line! And angles on a straight line add up to 180. So 50 plus 60 plus 70 is 180. Look at the tall bar: all three together.

explain.say: Brilliant! The proof uses parallel lines: two Z angles copy the bottom angles up to the top. Wow: a giant triangle drawn on the curved Earth has angles adding to more than 180! Challenge: a triangle has angles of 90 and 35. What is the third?

faq.q: Why do the angles in a triangle add to 180?
faq.a: If you tear off the three corners and put them side by side, they make a straight line, and a straight line is 180 degrees.

faq.q: How can you prove the angles add to 180?
faq.a: Draw a line through the top corner, parallel to the base. The two Z, or alternate, angles equal the bottom angles, and all three fit on the straight line, making 180.

faq.q: How do you find the third angle of a triangle?
faq.a: Add the two angles you know and take the total from 180. For 90 and 35, the third angle is 180 minus 125, which is 55 degrees.

faq.q: Can a triangle have two right angles?
faq.a: No. Two right angles already make 180, leaving nothing for the third angle, so the sides could never meet.
asks: Can a triangle have two 90 degree angles?

faq.q: Why do triangles on a globe add to more than 180?
faq.a: On a curved surface the sides bulge outward. A triangle from the North Pole down to the equator and a quarter of the way round has three right angles, 270 degrees.
asks: Do triangle angles always add to 180?

facts: The angles of any flat triangle add up to 180°.
On a sphere, the angles of a triangle add up to more than 180°.
